paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov bar Ami or Imi.

In [Sanhedrin 20b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.20b.3), Rabbi Yaakov bar Ami says, “If the bed’s canopy poles protrude, stand it upright and that is enough.” Hyman cites Nedarim 56a for the form Bar Acha and refers to that entry. The parallel is in [Nedarim 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.56b.5). He also cites the beginning of chapter 6 of Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot for Rabbi Yaakov bar Ami speaking in Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish’s name.[^1]

notes.text: Nedarim 56b has Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha reporting the same ruling in Rabbi’s name. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2136&lang=en) likewise reports the Jerusalem Talmud attribution, with the form Imi. The consulted opening of the chapter does not establish that chain.
